description: One print of the monthly change notice for one person. It records that the page content was released, which changed days were on which page, and - once the person has signed or objected - who recorded that and when. It never holds the reason text, the times or the hours: those live on the Attendance Request and are only fingerprinted here (088 OPS-20).

fields.description: The first day of the month the notice covers.
fields.label: Month

fields.description: Who the server released the page content to. 'Printed' means released, not that paper came out (088 SEC-2).
fields.label: Printed By

fields.description: How many A4 pages this print made.
fields.label: Page Count

fields.description: Printed: the page went out and nobody has answered yet. Signed: the person signed or thumb-printed it. Not right: the person said it is wrong, and no change was marked.
fields.label: Outcome

fields.description: The HR person who recorded the answer. Never the person who filed one of the changes on the page.
fields.label: Recorded By

fields.description: What the person said was wrong, in their own words as HR wrote them down.
fields.label: What They Said

fields.description: A photo of each signed page. Empty until the signature is recorded.
fields.label: Signed Pages

name: Alvoraa Register Notice
